name: pgt-sistema-imoveis
description: Sistema completo para gestão de imóveis rurais e urbanos com IA

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deploy:push: git add . && git commit -m "🚀 Deploy: Atualização" && git push origin main
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && npm run deploy:push
